protocol.target: Five-minute future BID close movement divided by current ATR; future values used only as training labels
protocol.entry: Forecast absolute mean exceeds current observed spread + $0.07 commission + $0.10 adverse slippage + 0.05 ATR. No trade quota.
protocol.execution: Retained original bid/ask ticks; 200/500ms delays, commission3.5/lot/side, slippage.02/.05, .01 lot floors,100oz contract,100x leverage,50%entrymargin,15%daily/60%peak experimental limits
protocol.acceptance: At $500/1%: positive net expectancy >=0.15R and PF>=1.4 in BOTH validation and test under base and stressed costs; >=5 decisions per observed weekday in each. These are product screening criteria, never entry quotas.
limitations: October was viewed in earlier research; new model fitting is chronologically separated but market period is not pristine unseen data.
No feature/threshold/hyperparameter selection using validation or test results. No defaults promotion based on one month.
Conditional-return estimation does not itself establish a tradeable edge. No annualization or monthly growth guarantee.

source_manifest.volumeMeaning: Observed quote count, not traded volume
limitations: Exness Raw Spread reference; not JustMarkets or a prop firm fill record
No invented quotes, spreads or weekend bars
Commission, latency, fill reserve and lot/margin rules are scenarios
